transcript.text: Good morning. I'd like to get ahead of the Friday roster review. We need to confirm qualifications for the Saturday dispatch desk and Sunday communications-log desk. Our available personnel are SPC Jordan, PFC Malik, and SPC Chen. Motor transport NCO and signal NCO — can you each confirm which of these three are qualified for your respective posts, and flag any control entries we need before I sign the roster?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Regarding the Saturday dispatch desk: SPC Jordan's current dispatch certification is valid for the 0800-1200 shift. I confirmed Jordan's status this morning. However, SPC Chen's replacement certification is still pending in the motor-pool training database, and the database synchronization has not reached battalion personnel yet. So from the motor transport side, Jordan is qualified; Chen is not yet qualified for the dispatch desk.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Regarding the Sunday communications-log desk: PFC Malik's signed communications-log qualification is valid for the 0800-1200 shift. I received Malik's signed certificate yesterday, but the scanned copy has not yet been posted to the personnel folder. SPC Chen has not completed the required logkeeping refresher, so Chen is not qualified for the communications-log desk.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Flag SPC Chen as not yet qualified for the Saturday dispatch desk due to pending replacement certification not synced to battalion personnel.
Flag SPC Chen as not qualified for the Sunday communications-log desk due to incomplete logkeeping refresher.
Ensure scanned copy of Malik's signed communications-log certificate is posted to the personnel folder.
